description_expanded: ABOUT VITAMIN SEA: Welcome to Vitamin Sea, the perfect 30A vacation rental for your next beach escape! This condo rental is located in the breathtaking Watersound Beach Community in 30A. This luxurious 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath Florida vacation rental offers panoramic views of the Gulf and the stunning coastal dune lake. Vitamin Sea features two king ensuite bedrooms and one queen bedroom, providing ample space and comfort for you and your guests. As a bonus, the condo comes with four complimentary bike rentals, perfect for exploring the scenic surroundings, and six beach towels for your relaxation by the pool or the private beach at Watersound. Enjoy being less than a five-minute walk to the beach and close to other area attractions like local restaurants and shops. Whether enjoying the picturesque views from your balcony or taking a leisurely stroll along the pristine sandy beaches, this Watersound Beach rental promises a truly unforgettable coastal living experience. ABOUT THE AREA Located along Highway 30A, Watersound Beach is a picturesque coastal community on the Florida Emerald Coast. This beachside town is known for its white sandy beaches, serene atmosphere, and turquoise waters. It is the perfect tranquil retreat for visitors seeking natural beauty and relaxation. The wide, soft, powdery sand beach in this 30A community is ideal for sunset strolls, building sandcastles, and sunbathing. The Gulf of Mexico waters are suited for a variety of aquatic things to do, including swimming, snorkeling, kayaking, and paddleboarding. Thanks to the refreshing sea breeze and gentle waves, Watersound Beach is a peaceful haven for beachgoers. Watersound Beach is home to more than an incredible shoreline. Conservation areas, coastal cubes, and native vegetation surrounded the town, creating a sense of tranquility and seclusion. The area's architecture is inspired by traditional coastal design, combining charming beach cottages, pastel-colored homes, lush surroundings, and natural surroundings. During your Florida vacation to Watersound Beach, you can enjoy a wide assortment of amenities and activities. Bike along scenic 30A pathways, try your hand at watersports, or explore nearby Florida state parks. Dine at waterfront 30A restaurants and shop at boutique stores. Whether you're looking for things to do outdoors, cultural experiences, or simply a place to unwind and connect with nature, Watersound Beach provides a perfect setting for a memorable Florida beach vacation. BEACH ACCESS: There is private beach access for guests staying at this Watersound Beach rental. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: - Private beach access - 6 beach towels - 4 complimentary bikes - Newly updated - Beachfront location - Gulf views PARKING: - Free parking for up to 2 vehicles PROPERTY RULES: - Must sign a rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation - Must be 25 years or older to reserve this 30A condo rental - No pets allowed - Guests do not have access to Watersound Beach Club ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.
